title: Invite a teammate, then let them connect as themselves.
text: On a server without company sign-in, an organization admin runs yoke invite NAME or uses Team → Invite. This creates a separate person with the chosen role, defaulting to operator; an identical display name is not an identity match. Send the one-time code privately. The teammate chooses Enter invite code in yoke setup --tui before its 24-hour expiry. Agent mode hands this secret step to the person, then resumes; never supply the code through --answer. Lost, expired or consumed codes need admin reissue, which keeps the same person and invalidates earlier codes. Hosted and company-sign-in invitations take email; the teammate signs in as themselves, never through the inviter's own-machine approval.
verification: Real invite transactions, private CLI redemption and Team source tests cover actor binding, one-use delivery and recovery. Deployed and scripted journey proof remains owed.
